feedback.description: AC-02 (multi-skill / unusual certificate) THEN clause requires 'each confirmed skill is written to the profile as verified' and 'ambiguous fields do not break the write'. The test (cert-parsing.test.ts:53-63) only asserts parsed.skills.length >= 2 from the parse output; it never calls confirmAndWriteSkill for the extracted skills, so it does not assert multiple verified records are written nor that null/ambiguous fields (date:null, level:null in the fixture) still allow a successful write. The write half of the AC is uncovered.
feedback.suggestion: Extend the AC-02 test to confirmAndWriteSkill for each extracted skill (including the one with null date/level) and assert each is written {source:'certificate', state:'verified', verified:true} and that the row count increased by the number of valid skills — proving ambiguous optional fields do not break the write.

feedback.description: AC-04 / BR-04 core differentiator is 'the ranking reasons over availability (free now / within 2 weeks), not skills alone'. The test (staffing-matcher.test.ts:60-62) asserts only that one of the mock's own scripted availability strings matches /free now|within 2 weeks/. This is near-tautological: it passes for any implementation that echoes Claude's output and does NOT distinguish availability-aware ranking from skill-only ranking. The behavior that makes AC-04 meaningful is unasserted.
feedback.suggestion: Strengthen the assertion so availability demonstrably drives ordering — e.g. script two candidates where the lower-skilled but 'free now' candidate is ranked above a higher-skilled 'free in 8 weeks' candidate, and assert the ordering/rank reflects availability rather than match% alone (or assert each shortlist entry carries an availability field that the rationale references). Keep the call-boundary assertion.

feedback.description: Hero loop (hero-loop.test.ts) asserts createdNewRow===false, no row-count growth, and promoted state==='verified' — strong protection of BR-18. It does not assert the promoted record's source becomes 'certificate' after promotion (AC-07 ties the rank lift to a cert-driven verified promotion). AC-22's profile-skills test similarly asserts state but not source on the promoted row.
feedback.suggestion: Add a single assertion in hero-loop.test.ts (or AC-22 upsert test) that the promoted record's source is 'certificate' (alongside state 'verified') after uploadAndPromoteCert, locking the verified promotion to its cert origin per BR-01/BR-18.
